name: Tap Symphony
shortDescription: Rhythm-based addictive tapping game with dynamic difficulty and competitive leaderboard
fullDescription: Tap Symphony is a mobile-first rhythm game that challenges your timing and reflexes. Tap to the beat with perfect rhythm to achieve high scores, build combos, and unlock difficulty levels. Features procedurally-generated beat patterns, real-time feedback, and endless gameplay mode.

generation.notes: Ultra-Compact pipeline execution. Game includes dynamic difficulty scaling (levels 1-4), combo system with 5x multiplier cap, real-time beat timing validation, procedural sequence generation, and comprehensive game-over analytics. Mobile-optimized with touch and keyboard controls.
